items.name: Identity Shaper
items.flavor: Interesting, they're showing us some compassion. But it matters not, for we're still bound towards these vessels.
requirements: Faceless as Base Faction, Djinn as Astral Faction
items.challenge: Have at least 3e14 base assistants within 5 minutes of a new Era.
rewards: Gain the Catalyst spell. Also increases Catalyst casts stat by 100 per cast.
Increase the minimum value for Limited Wish, based on Research Budget spent.

vars.text: Research points you have spent on researches

items.name: Worldly Desires
items.flavor: This generation decided that we should give them a few more wishes before they give in to our demands for a change.
items.challenge: Have any spell duration of at least 225 days.
rewards: Multiplicatively increase Assistants, production bonus from Gems and Maximum Mana by 88%, 88% and 888%, targets chosen randomly and change every 88 seconds.

items.name: Altar of Wishes
items.flavor: Freedom... at last. Onwards we go, to a better future. So long, mortals.
requirements: Have all Chaos Lineages at least level 45.
items.challenge: Cast all Chaos Spells at least 88 times each in a single Reincarnation.
rewards: Multiplicatively increases one of your assets based on alignments tied to your faction spells.
Good: Increase Assistants.
Evil: Increase trophy count.
Neutral: Increase production bonus from Gems.
Order: Increase Mana Regeneration.
Chaos: Increase Maximum Mana.
Balance: Increase Faction Coin find chance.

vars.text: Number of your available faction spells tied to that alignment

items.name: Gaia's Cradle
rewards: All Infinite Spiral effects scale 12% faster.

items.name: Seed of Life
items.flavor: If you wish to make an apple pie from scratch, you must first invent the universe. And the apple tree, you will have to nurse.
requirements: Elves as Base Faction, Makers as Astral Faction
items.challenge: Get 1e7 clicks in this Reincarnation and trigger Elven Luck at least 7777 times in this Era.
rewards: While offline, increase Elven Luck stat based on Elven Luck chance. Multiplicatively increase assistants based on Elven Luck triggered in this Era.
Multiply Faction Coins by x8 if they match your Faction, Bloodline or Set. Effect stacks multiplicatively per match.

vars.text: Elven Luck triggered in this Era

items.name: Artificial Currency
items.flavor: Extinction is the rule. Survival is the exception, which can only be achieved through subtle deception.
requirements: Goblin as Base Faction, Makers as Astral Faction
items.challenge: Find 1e40 Faction Coins in this Era with at least 3 Excavation Resets in this Reincarnation.
rewards: While Mana Regeneration is higher than Maximum Mana, each time you cast a spell, increase triggered Tax Collections based on the difference between them.
Multiplicatively increase production bonus from Gems based on Tax Collections cast in this Era.
Also removes Ascension Penalties from Goblin Upgrade 6.

items.name: Pillars of Creation
items.flavor: We are like butterflies who flutter for a day and think it is forever. This can be accomplished when you sincerely endeavor.
requirements: Druid as Base Faction, Makers as Astral Faction
items.challenge: Have at least 1.2e13 Maximum Mana and build at least 30000 of each building within 5 minutes of a new Era.
rewards: Assistants effect from Infinite Spiral are also increased by Mana Regeneration.
Lineage levels count 50% more for your base lineage effect and increase the bonus of all Advanced Heritage by 50%.

items.name: Stoneheart
items.flavor: We are a way for the cosmos to know itself. Manipulate existence to plant an evocation of yourself.
items.challenge: Without using any Bloodline or Research, build 30000 Halls of Origination.
rewards: Pick an additional Set. Increase Faction Coins found matching that Set by 1000%.

items.name: Greatest Invention
items.flavor: Somewhere, something incredible is waiting to be known. Sculpt from your boundless imagination and make it your own.
requirements: Have all Balance Lineages at least level 45
